release.description: The adjustment field on a proposal line is relabelled for screen readers and the new help text

failures.title: BR-04 printed USD lines add up to the subtotal, each line rounded in the invoice currency before tax @critical
BR-04 SEK line amounts at exactly half an öre round half away from zero @critical
BR-04 tax is worked out on each line after it is converted and rounded to the customer currency, and the total adds up the rounded lines @critical
BR-07 write-downs over 10% of a proposal wait for a billing manager approval before it can be finalised @critical
BR-06 a write-up needs a reason

repair.cause: The adjustment field's aria-label on Billing.Web/Pages/Proposals/Edit.cshtml changed from "Adjustment for line @l.Sequence" to "Write-up or write-down for line @l.Sequence", so ProposalPage.adjust looked for a label that no longer exists and the tests timed out.
repair.fix_summary: In pages/ProposalPage.ts, adjust now finds the field by the new label "Write-up or write-down for line ${sequence}"; no test checks change, and the other four specs are not in the material, so it cannot be confirmed that this alone fixes them.
